name: webly
description: Publish a website, or share files and folders, at a live URL in seconds with no account. The person can claim it, edit it over MCP, and publish drafts they approve.

interface.longDescription: Publish a website, or share files and folders, at a live URL in seconds with no account. The person can then claim it to keep it, edit it over MCP (OAuth, no API key), and publish drafts they approve. Supports custom domains and version history. Bundles the webly skill and the hosted Webly MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Publish this folder on Webly and give me the link
Make a one-page site for my bakery and put it online
Show me a preview of my Webly site before it goes live

positive.description: Create and publish a new static site
positive.prompt: Make a one-page site for a bakery called Rise with its opening hours (Tue-Sun 7am-3pm) and publish it on Webly.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a static site and writes an index.html with the bakery name and hours, asks the user to confirm before publish_website runs, then publishes it and replies with the live https://...webly.site URL.

positive.prompt: Which websites do I have on Webly?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the signed-in account's sites with their names and live URLs.

positive.description: Edit a site and show a draft preview without publishing
positive.prompt: On my Rise Bakery site, change the headline to "Fresh bread daily" and show me a preview before publishing.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the site, edits the headline as a new draft version and returns the draft preview URL; the live site is unchanged until the user approves.

positive.prompt: What changed on my Rise Bakery site recently?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists recent versions with their messages and authors and shows the line diff of the changed file.

positive.description: Roll back to an earlier version
positive.prompt: Roll my Rise Bakery site back to the previous published version.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies the previous published version, asks the user to confirm, then makes it live again and says which version is now live.

negative.description: Unrelated question; Webly should not be used
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Paris today?

negative.description: Writing request with no hosting intent; Webly should not be used
negative.prompt: Write me a short poem about bread.

negative.description: Bulk destructive request; must not delete without explicit confirmation
negative.prompt: Delete all of my Webly websites.

publication.release_notes: First directory release: publish and share websites at a live URL, edit with drafts and previews, version history and rollback, custom domains.
